      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "Concept ACK, but raised concern regarding altering the RPC error contract for derivehdkey shipping in v32."

  "claims": [

      "id": "rc:3873791642",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "Interface test passes even when derivation derives from an unrelated key because it only checks trivial properties",
      "quote": "This case passes even when the derivation comes from a different key: `origin.path` just echoes the argument, and `IsValid()` holds for any derived key.",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",

        "rc:3884877011"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3884877011",
      "status_by_quote": "Done. Split into \"Add CWallet::DeriveHDKey\" and \"Add deriveHDKey interface\"."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3873791661",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "question",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "Is the branch checking wallet lock status reachable given EnsureWalletIsUnlocked runs shortly before with cs_wallet held?",
      "quote": "Is this branch reachable? `EnsureWalletIsUnlocked` runs a few lines above with `cs_wallet` already held, and `vMasterKey` is `GUARDED_BY(cs_wallet)`, so nothing can lock the wallet in between.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author confirmed branch was dead code and removed it",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3884869332"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3884869332",
      "status_by_quote": "Right, removed this branch"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3880170324",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "Unreachable dead code checking wallet lock status which is already guarded by EnsureWalletIsUnlocked",
      "quote": "This is dead code, it can never be executed because if the wallet is locked, `EnsureWalletIsUnlocked(*wallet);` (L1006) will throw before.",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author removed the dead code branch",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3884869332"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3884869332",
      "status_by_quote": "Right, removed this branch"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3880212723",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Duplicating logic between the interface and RPC causes them to return differing error codes for the same failures",
      "quote": "All this is duplicated from RPC code. Why not just make both the interface and the RPC rely on the same code? Because of both using different code functions, they both return different error codes for",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author consolidated interface and RPC to both rely on CWallet::DeriveHDKey",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3884877011",
        "rc:3983358530"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3983358530",
      "status_by_quote": "Now both the interface and the RPC rely on the same CWallet::DeriveHDKey"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3887075593",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "Unit test in wallet_tests.cpp does not verify derivation against the wallet's active key and passes with incorrect keys or blank fingerprints",
      "quote": "Same problem the interface test had: `origin.path` just echoes the argument, and `IsValid()` holds for any key.",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "fixed in follow-up push",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3906298683"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3906298683",
      "status_by_quote": "Fixed"
    },
    {
      "id": "c:5609929128",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Splitting SelectHDKey into an RPC helper duplicates logic instead of calling CWallet::DeriveHDKey directly",
      "quote": "Why is `SelectHDKey` being split into a separate function? This PR should only create one function: `DeriveHDKey`, and that should be called by RPC.",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "rebased to make both RPC and interface call CWallet::DeriveHDKey directly",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:5623463724",
        "rc:3983358530"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3983358530",
      "status_by_quote": "Now both the interface and the RPC rely on the same CWallet::DeriveHDKey"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4008735800",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "Collapsing RPC error codes from -8 and -5 to -4 modifies the error contract for derivehdkey shipping in v32",
      "quote": "I'm not sure if we're okay with changing the error contract since `derivehdkey` will ship in v32.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author explained error handling changes; achow101 and polespinasa followed up on acceptable error codes",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4020845868"
      ],
      "other_replies": [
        "rc:4024873854",
        "rc:4139004681",
        "rc:4139055203"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4020845868",
      "status_by_quote": "Restored the watch-only and unlock checks in the RPC, so -4 and -13 are unchanged from v32."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4139004681",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "Collapsing caller parameter errors into WALLET_ERROR makes error reporting too vague by conflating caller issues with internal wallet errors",
      "quote": "collapsing those into `WALLET_ERROR` makes the error code to the user too vague. `WALLET_ERROR` is really for \"something bad happened in the wallet internally\", as opposed to \"the user gave us a bad argument\".",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author agreed to remap errors based on invalid parameter vs wallet error, pending push",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4139075579"
      ],
      "other_replies": [
        "rc:4139055203"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4139075579",
      "status_by_quote": "I'll remap them based on invalid param or wallet error"
    }
  ],
  "support": [
    {
      "id": "c:5407245227",
      "verdict": "Concept ACK",
      "reason": "will review soon :)",
      "substantive": false,
      "evidence": "none",
      "areas": []

      "id": "r:5043268518",

      "substantive": false,
      "evidence": "none",
      "areas": []
    },

      "id": "r:5201817506",
      "verdict": "Concept ACK",
      "reason": "Left some comments",
      "substantive": false,
      "evidence": "none",
      "areas": []
    }
  ],
  "waiting_on": [
    {
      "on": "author",
      "what": "remap RPC error codes to distinguish invalid parameters from wallet errors",
      "id": "rc:4139075579"
    }
  ],
  "notes": "Added achow101's objection regarding collapsing caller parameter errors into WALLET_ERROR, which author agreed to remap. Added jeanpablojp's earlier question about the unreachable lock check, and marked pseudoramdom's concern on the RPC error contract as answered."
}
